name: stemix-idp-backstage
description: Backstage test harness for Stemix IDP plug-in integration.

scripts.build:stemix: yarn workspace @ourchitecture/backstage-plugin-stemix build && yarn workspace @ourchitecture/backstage-plugin-stemix-backend build
scripts.typecheck:stemix: yarn workspace @ourchitecture/backstage-plugin-stemix typecheck && yarn workspace @ourchitecture/backstage-plugin-stemix-backend typecheck
scripts.test:stemix: yarn workspace @ourchitecture/backstage-plugin-stemix test && yarn workspace @ourchitecture/backstage-plugin-stemix-backend test
scripts.check:stemix: yarn run build:stemix && yarn run typecheck:stemix && yarn run test:stemix
scripts.fix: yarn run clean && yarn workspaces foreach -A run lint
